request.reason: Complete the high-risk release Contract with the exact planned scenarios and expected results from the already authorized scope; this adds plans only and claims no executed evidence.

value.expected: The current candidate metadata and built package identify version 1.0.1 as stable without a prerelease suffix; historical v1.0.1-rc.2 remains a separate immutable prerelease.
value.verificationPlan: Inspect Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, candidate metadata, version output from each built target, and localized release/version documents; verify historical prerelease labels remain accurate.

value.expected: Every required repository and release gate passes on the exact candidate PR head, including actual coverage completion for all 13 packages.
value.verificationPlan: Run the existing required PR CI and release validation route; bind run ID, exact head SHA, job statuses, package coverage outputs, and any produced artifacts.

value.expected: Candidate build and installation smoke pass for Apple Silicon macOS Homebrew, x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, and x86_64-pc-windows-msvc, including each target's declared doctor/smoke checks.
value.verificationPlan: Use the existing release workflow's Homebrew, Linux, and Windows candidate smoke jobs and retain per-target build, install, doctor, and cleanup evidence.

value.expected: Only x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu runs the full upgrade from the immediately previous stable release to candidate 1.0.1, and the upgraded installation passes its declared doctor checks.
value.verificationPlan: After confirming the immutable previous stable tag and candidate identity, execute the existing N-1 acceptance path only for x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu; preserve installed-version, upgrade, and post-upgrade doctor output.

value.expected: On the local Apple Silicon macOS host, CLI and MCP invocation switching resolves each configured repository identity to its intended root without changing provider-global configuration.
value.verificationPlan: Run the declared local CLI/MCP identity-switch checks against both configured repository roots and preserve invocation, identity, and cleanup evidence.

value.expected: Only after the other release scenarios pass and Runtime admits the bound resource plan, stable v1.0.1 is published with assets matching the accepted candidate; no existing immutable tag or asset is replaced.
value.verificationPlan: At the publication boundary, query the exact tag and Release identity, obtain the Runtime-admitted finalization plan and current human decision, publish only if the name is unused and evidence is fresh, then verify tag, Release, and asset digests.

acceptanceCriteria: The source diff changes only the 16 declared paths; current release metadata identifies v1.0.1 as stable with no prerelease suffix, while historical prerelease references remain accurately labeled.
The repository Rust and documentation/package gates pass on the exact candidate head, with evidence showing all 13 package coverage obligations completed.

The existing release workflow builds and candidate-install-smokes aarch64-apple-darwin via Homebrew, x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, and x86_64-pc-windows-msvc; each target runs its declared doctor/smoke checks.
Full N-1 upgrade acceptance runs only on x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu against the previous stable release, with installed version, upgrade result, and post-upgrade doctor evidence bound to the candidate.

On the local Apple Silicon macOS host, CLI and MCP checks switch between two configured repository identities and confirm each invocation resolves to the intended repository without mutating provider-global configuration.

An exact-head PR has all required repository and release gates green; a stable v1.0.1 tag and public Release are created only after the preceding acceptance evidence is current and Runtime admits publication, without replacing rc.2 or other immutable resources.
previousContract.goal: Starting from main c417b65c3f3608b7fd2336314d7432fd72fa8723, make and verify the exact 16-path stable v1.0.1 update; pass exact-head repository CI and release gates; prove candidate build/install smoke for Apple Silicon macOS Homebrew, Linux x86_64 GNU, Linux ARM64 GNU, and Windows x86_64 MSVC; run full N-1 acceptance only on Linux x86_64; verify local macOS CLI/MCP identity switching; then publish stable v1.0.1 only after Runtime-admitted Contract review and current acceptance evidence. Do not overwrite any existing tag or immutable release asset.
previousContract.intent: Prepare the existing v1.0.1 line as a genuine stable release rather than a prerelease, with corrected release identity and consistent localized version/distribution documentation.
outOfScope: Any product or governance path outside the 16-path allowlist; .github/workflows/release.yml unless a demonstrated defect requires a separately admitted amendment; editing historical evidence; merging before exact-head CI and required review; tagging or publishing before Contract review and candidate acceptance.
